list.lead: What each notification says, by email, in Teams and in Slack, in English and in French. An edited template replaces the built-in one for the notifications sent from then on; the greeting, the facts and the button stay rvav's.

textHint.slack: The message's text, in Slack's mrkdwn: what variables hold is escaped.
